findings.finding: AW9 sampler uses multinomial(mu,1).squeeze(-1) -> (B,); gather uses action[:,None] -> (B,1), then squeeze(1). SAC validates 0<=actions<9. No out-of-range access in captured failing forward (failure precedes gather).
No scatter/index_select in the shared encoder/actor forward. Replay selection uses numpy choice without replacement and the same Transition order for every field.

Both collection runners enumerate active slots, stack in that order, and map row back to slot with enumerate/zip. Bad rows originated from active agents and became inactive only in next_obs; provenance uses original Transition object identity and replay slot, without changing RNG.

Environment _pad uses np.zeros, masks are exact 22 entries, types are range0..3. Valid self flag is always true in packed active observations. Runners zero all fields for None next_obs, intentionally creating an all-false validity mask. This is the proven invalid attention-domain boundary.

Observed B128,H8,T22,D32 QKV; bool padding mask B128,T22. has_evader is B and scores mask is B,1,E8; summary padding B,3; pursuing_scalar B,1; no accidental broadcasting across batch. A1 old harness (B,1) vs (B,) bug is test-only and independent of this production source.

Key padding all true maps to all -inf native softmax row. Pool masks would zero masked values afterwards, but self_token=trans[:,0] remains NaN. Existing max_context isfinite fallback cannot prevent this source. Summary attention always has mean/max slots unmasked; empty-enemy guarded target attention is not first bad op.

Input, masks, model parameters and QKV finite; no torch.empty in this shared forward. Single-row failure deterministic 1111/1111, insensitive to full/reversed/duplicated batching; CPU matches CUDA. Evidence supports row-local all-masked attention, not stale memory or undefined indexing.

Both failing rows terminated=true,truncated=false; original input represented no physical active next state. Valid truncated states retain self=true. Learners multiply bootstrap by ~terminated AFTER forward; 0*NaN propagates. Fix leaves that scientific contract unchanged.
